MARKETING_ANALYTICS.TITLE: Marketing Analytics
MARKETING_ANALYTICS.DESCRIPTION: Send conversion events to Meta and Google when leads reach a funnel stage, get labeled, or trigger an automation.
MARKETING_ANALYTICS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect this integration? Existing dispatches stay in history.

META_CAPI.DESCRIPTION: Meta Conversions API. Used for WhatsApp / Instagram DM / Facebook Messenger ads. Fires with the ctwa_clid captured on the first inbound.

GOOGLE_ADS_ENHANCED.DESCRIPTION: Google Ads uploadClickConversions. Uses the gclid captured by the landing page snippet in the first message.

EVENTS.TITLE: Conversion events
EVENTS.DESCRIPTION: Map a Chatwoot trigger to a Meta event name and/or a Google conversion action.
EVENTS.NAME: Name
EVENTS.LABEL: Label
EVENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the event "{name}"? Existing dispatches stay in history.
